review_target.role: retained sole current-main binder generator lane

source_observation.finding: The retained generator selects lexical_variant_index as (block_id + perm_index + template_index + polarity_index + base_class_index) modulo the number of variants.
source_observation.risk: Because block_id and perm_index also determine the episode-local symbol mapping, lexical surface selection is statistically coupled to target symbols outside the codebook.
source_observation.why_existing_balance_is_insufficient: Exact marginal class-symbol balance does not prove conditional independence from non-codebook text. A model can exploit a higher-order interaction among template, polarity, semantic state and lexical variant while every one-dimensional marginal remains balanced.

current_formula_one_atom_block.interpretation: The leak is interaction-level rather than visible in the major one-dimensional marginals.

minimal_repair_formula_one_atom_block.change: Remove block_id and perm_index from lexical-variant selection so lexical surface is independent of symbol-set identity and S3 mapping.

preferred_quality_repair.design: Factor lexical_variant_index independently rather than deriving it from mapping variables. Loop over all three lexical variants for every S3/template/polarity/base-class cell.
preferred_quality_repair.factorization: 6 S3 mappings x 4 template families x 2 query polarities x 3 base semantic classes x 3 lexical variants
preferred_quality_repair.benefit: Every exact non-codebook lexical surface is exposed under all six S3 mappings, preserving lexical diversity while making target-symbol prediction from outside-codebook text exactly uninformative within the deterministic design.

swarm_review.ADVERSARIAL_SHORTCUT_HUNTER: FAIL_CURRENT_GENERATOR: non-codebook interaction leaks target information despite exact marginal class-symbol balance.

swarm_review.PARALLEL_WORK_DEDUP_REVIEWER: PASS: no second binder generator was persisted; only a linter/test/research delta is added around the retained main generator.

training_data_implication.do_now: Repair lexical-variant scheduling, then rerun the retained generator and linter before materializing real-atom training rows.
training_data_implication.do_not_do: Do not scale the current 144-row/block curriculum merely because class-symbol counts are equal; the interaction leak can reward a lexical shortcut.
training_data_implication.next_curriculum_phase_after_repair: Add balanced 2-4 hop dereference/distractor families as a separate family within the retained generator architecture, motivated by variable-binding research, after one-hop shortcut closure.

next_exact_action: Patch the retained context-binding generator so lexical realization is independent of block_id and s3_permutation, preferably by full lexical-variant factorization; then generate demo rows, run the existing generator validator plus the new non-codebook shortcut linter, and require both to pass before the real 46-atom tranche.
